objective: Test whether the observed high-size performance region remains stable as the same table grows cumulatively from one to 36 months, and whether a single explicit read schema works across mixed absent/present PULocationID epochs.
windows: 24 and 36 cumulative months for schema_evolution projection
design: three seeded randomized complete blocks after one warmup/window
responses: decoded bytes and rows per task
interpretation: Growth changes task waves and tail effects while the per-task target is held by the candidate. Mixed schema uses explicit requested Long PULocationID; absent older values materialize null. This is not an automatic Parquet upcast test.
